title: On the second homology of the genus 3 hyperelliptic Torelli group
summary: Let $s$ be a fixed hyperelliptic involution of the closed, oriented genus $g$ surface $Σ_g$. The hyperelliptic Torelli group $\mathcal{SI}_g$ is the subgroup of the mapping class group $\mathrm{Mod}(Σ_g)$ consisting of elements that act trivially on $\mathrm{H}_1(Σ_g;\mathbb{Z})$ and commute with $s$. It is generated by Dehn twists about $s$-invariant separating curves, and its cohomological dimension is $g-1$.
